meta.title: SkillRoster: inspect first, mutate explicitly
meta.subtitle: Local CLI implementation · discovery → immutable Plan → guarded Apply / receipt-based Undo

components.label: Installed Skills + evidence
components.explanation: Discovery reads known Agent roots, shared and managed Library roots, explicit roots, frozen durable-read roots, and Codex plugin roots. Plugin placements are observed as non-governable. Session evidence is optional. A readable root is not automatically a permitted mutation target. The write surface below overlaps only the governable portion of this read surface; they are not two copies of Skill content.

components.label: Discovery + snapshot capture
components.explanation: app::scan_command freezes source permissions, invokes scan::scan, checks permissions again, then persists the inventory and ScanResult in a SQLite snapshot transaction. scan.rs parses bounded SKILL.md reads, hashes packages, records placements and coverage, and optionally scans sessions. This is read-only with respect to observed Skill content, not with respect to SkillRoster's own state directory.

components.label: SQLite StateStore
components.explanation: Durable local inventory, Evidence, Findings/reports, prepared Plans, Roster/Library governance metadata and Receipts. Scan persists an indexed snapshot; planning reads the latest snapshot and saves a Plan. Apply/Undo load those records and finalize governance plus receipt state. SQLite and filesystem journals are separate persistence domains, not a single atomic transaction.

sources.label: Secure state, acquire lock, open SQLite

components.label: Declarative Plan preparation
components.explanation: The caller supplies intent as JSON, not arbitrary filesystem instructions. normalize_agent_plan rejects caller-authored operations and derives trusted Roster/Library/source-update operations. prepare_plan binds the latest Snapshot and Evidence, validates governance and physical preconditions, and saves the prepared Plan. change::prepare computes a SHA-256 digest and records approved roots, fingerprints and projections. Plan preview reports files_changed=false: that does not mean no SQLite or owned-detail-file writes.

sources.label: Reject raw operations; derive trusted ones

components.label: Apply / Undo coordinator
components.explanation: An explicit Apply or Undo CLI invocation enters this boundary; preparing a Plan never executes it. Non-JSON mode prompts for confirmation; JSON mode relies on explicit caller invocation and does not prompt. Apply requires a ready Plan, clear recovery state, the same latest Snapshot, matching governance/placement/Evidence state, then calls change::apply_locked. Undo requires an applied Receipt not already reversed. After filesystem verification, the coordinator updates or restores Roster/Library metadata and saves a Receipt; metadata failure can trigger rollback or recovery_required.

components.label: Change engine + anchored I/O
components.explanation: The engine opens handle-anchored approved roots via StateLock. Apply revalidates the prepared Plan, operation sequence and package projections, refuses unresolved recovery, and requires atomic no-replace rename support. It journals pending operations and compensations, performs operations, checks postconditions, and compensates on failure. Undo journals a new reverse Receipt and executes saved compensations in reverse order with fingerprint/missing-target checks; drift is refused rather than overwriting unrelated changes. The grouped anchored adapter owns actual file writes, renames, symlinks and durability barriers.

components.label: Durable journals + recovery
components.explanation: ChangeReceipt journals carry changed paths, operation results, compensation data and state. persist_journal_with serializes to a private temporary file and publishes through the anchored atomic-file routine, which syncs the file and parent. Undo stashes created content in recovery storage or restores saved content/links rather than blindly deleting canonical Skill content. An unresolved journal can block later writes even if SQLite finalization failed; this is not evidence of atomicity across SQLite and the filesystem.

components.label: Approved mutable paths
components.explanation: Only derived, approved operation targets reach anchored mutation: Agent Skill placements, managed Library and plan-backup paths as appropriate. Read permission does not imply write permission. This store is a write-oriented view of eligible local files, overlapping the discovery read surface. Apply may include only governance metadata changes and no Skill-content operation. The engine checks package/path preconditions before and after mutation; Undo reverses only receipt-recorded changes.

cards.title: Caller chooses; Rust validates
items: scan discovers facts; report/find expose local evidence. plan consumes declarative JSON from stdin.
The caller invokes apply <plan_id> or undo <receipt_id> separately. Human mode prompts; JSON mode does not.

cards.title: Read-only is a content boundary
items: Scan persists SQLite inventory; Plan persists its bound proposal. Startup may create/secure local state and migrate the database.
Scan also takes an exclusive state lock (app.rs:569). A lock alone is not permission to mutate Skills.
Read permissions, provider-managed inventory and approved write roots are different capabilities.

cards.title: Failure and evidence limits
items: Apply failure → compensation; incomplete compensation or metadata restoration → recovery_required, blocking later Apply.
Successful Apply asks for a rescan; Undo invalidates a newer snapshot when needed. No cross-store atomicity or universal crash durability is claimed.
